messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick planning thread for candidate Lior (senior ML) on 2026-06-12. Arrival red-eye, estimated landing ~07:10. We have onsite loop 10:00-16:00. Needs: wheelchair access, halal lunch, quiet 1:1 room, and a loaner M1 Mac for the pairing exercise. Can we confirm badge, parking, and loaner pickup flow?
Ben Howard: I can reserve rooms. Suggest Conf C (3rd floor) for the coding quiet room; it's right by the ramp. Lunch table by window booked?
Aisha Khan: Yes, please book the window table for 12:30. Panel is 4 people so order for 5 (candidate + 4) with a halal + GF option.
Tara Li: Badge provisioning noted. I'll pre-create a day visitor badge. Name to use?
Aisha Khan: "Lior Patel" per passport. Also assign "visitor:contractor" role so door access to conf C works.
Mike Reynolds: Travel stipend handled. Sent email to Lior with expense form link and cc recruiter for receipts. I'll monitor flight.
PeopleOps Bot: Created checklist item: badge, loaner, catering, accessibility ramp. Flight watch enabled for LO-412. Will post ETA changes. :white_check_mark:
Ben Howard: Loaner inventory check: one M1 Mac available (asset tag M1-42). Plan: tag and leave in Locker A-3 with charger. Locker code?
Tara Li: I set locker code to 4821 and will DM front desk the pickup PIN. Image will be stock image (Chrome, Zoom, Slack). No corp keys. Candidate gets temporary VM creds for coding task.
Aisha Khan: Confirm the VM is preloaded with the test repo and instructions in README.md. Also please ensure accessibility ramp signage is visible.
Facilities: Parking pass reserved P2-7 for 06/12 06:00-06/13 18:00. Front desk notified; accessibility escort offered if needed. Signage placed at main entrance.
Ben Howard: Calendar update: first panel slot shifted 15m later to accommodate a panelist drop-in. Updated invites sent to interviewers and candidate. ICS: https://calendar.company/ical/2065004321
Mike Reynolds: Remote fallback plan: if flight delayed >30m, we'll switch to remote panel for the first session. Zoom link is included in invite and remote rooms prepped.
Tara Li: Catering placed with vendor. Halal + gluten-free clearly labeled. Delivery time 12:15 to conference kitchen.
Aisha Khan: Who will greet Lior at lobby? I'm on a morning flight and might not make it.
Ben Howard: I'll meet them at 07:45 and escort to front desk if Aisha misses it.
Mike Reynolds: I'll watch LO-412 and ping here if anything changes. PeopleOps Bot will also post updates.
PeopleOps Bot: Flight LO-412 status: scheduled. Will post gate and delay alerts to this thread.
Aisha Khan: Perfect. Thanks everyone 8578. I'll loop recruiter for any itinerary changes and confirm receipts process.
